observations: Photo 0: Close-up of a diesel engine valve cover reading 'DAF 24 VALVE', with another cast part marked 'DAF' and a partial number '1428063'. Surfaces show oil residue, grime, and corrosion typical of a used engine.

Photo 1: Same or similar engine sitting outdoors on bare ground, partially covered by a dirty tarp, surrounded by other stripped engines, gearboxes, and axle parts in what looks like a scrapyard or parts yard.
Photo 2: Wider yard view showing multiple engines (one with visible DAF markings) stacked together under tarps, with no sign of a vehicle, test rig, or power source nearby.
No oil/coolant level shots, no serial/VIN plate for the donor truck, no start-up or running footage, no view of the full engine (rear, sump, injector pump, turbo) is given.
Watermarks 'HEPH AUTOS' and 'Posted on Jiji' are overlaid on the images, consistent with a resale listing photo set, not an independent inspection.

risks.risk: Completeness is unclear: turbo, injector pump, alternator, starter, sump, and wiring loom may be missing or swapped, as the engine is surrounded by stripped parts in a yard.
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photos of the engine including rear flywheel housing, sump, turbo, and injector pump area.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming missing ancillaries (turbo, pumps, loom) unless shown

risks.risk: Exact model/variant (power rating, displacement) cannot be confirmed from the partial casting number, which affects compatibility and value.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the engine ID/serial plate with full model and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower end of the generic DAF 24-valve engine range

risks.risk: Storage outdoors under a tarp suggests prolonged exposure to weather, raising risk of rust in cylinders or seized components.
risks.proof: Photo/video of manual crank-over or turning the flywheel/pulley by hand to confirm free rotation.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running, with audible idle and rev-up.
Full engine ID/serial plate photo for exact model confirmation.
Photos from all sides including rear bell housing, sump, and turbo/injector pump area to confirm completeness.
Photo/video of hand-turning the crankshaft or flywheel to show it is not seized.
Close-up of any visible cracks, weld repairs, or oil leaks on the block and head.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used DAF 24-valve diesel engine from readable markings, but no proof of running condition, completeness, or exact model is given, so it must be priced at worst case as an untested, possibly incomplete pulled engine.
